standardError.rule: Reuse for all uncertainty in the estimate's stored units, including fractional rates. Never change global formatting to percent; explicitly label fractional SE units in rate-table notes and retain structured unit metadata.

proposedProperties.name: Benefit-cost ratio
proposedProperties.description: Ratio of discounted benefits to discounted costs under the stated accounting perspective and assumptions. A value of 2 means two units of benefit per unit of cost.
proposedProperties.searchStatus: Benefit, Cost-benefit, Benefit to cost and exact punctuation variants completed without a compatible candidate

proposedProperties.name: Tax deadweight loss
proposedProperties.description: Assumed additional welfare loss per unit of tax revenue raised, expressed as a fraction. A value of 0.5 means an additional loss of 50% of the revenue amount.
proposedProperties.searchStatus: Deadweight, Excess burden and Tax distortion completed without candidates

proposedProperties.name: Economic perspectives
proposedProperties.description: Accounting perspectives specifying whose costs and benefits enter an economic evaluation.
proposedProperties.searchStatus: Economic, Accounting and Analysis perspective variants completed without a compatible candidate; generic root Perspectives has undefined economic semantics

proposedProperties.name: Murder valuation
proposedProperties.description: Monetary value assigned to a murder in an economic model, interpreted with currency, price year and included harms.
proposedProperties.searchStatus: Crime valuation, Homicide valuation and exact Murder valuation completed without candidates

proposedProperties.name: Observed proportion
proposedProperties.description: Observed group proportion for a specified outcome and follow-up, expressed as a fraction. It is not a between-group causal effect.
proposedProperties.searchStatus: Proportion, Statistical mean and Group mean completed without candidates; Health Prevalence sampled and rejected because its datatype is Text

proposedProperties.name: Observed monetary mean
proposedProperties.description: Observed group mean of a monetary outcome, interpreted with currency, price year and follow-up. It is not a between-group causal effect.
proposedProperties.searchStatus: Statistical mean, Group mean, Observed monetary mean, Average earnings and Mean earnings completed without compatible candidates

invariants: All scenarios belong to one underlying study; pooled returns are not averages of sex-specific returns.
No crime valuation on individual-perspective returns; missing is not zero.

Original assignment counts are not per-outcome complete-case sample sizes.
Every numeric estimate and SE has matching units; source percent values are converted to fractions exactly.
